title: Bingo Volunteers Needed
summary: The Palm Hill Country Club needs enthusiastic Bingo Callers to volunteer for the Tuesday North Clubhouse bingo. Call once a month or fill in as needed.
_summary_source_original: Are you full of energy, love crowds, and want to help bring our community together? We are looking for enthusiastic, clear-voiced Bingo Callers to lead our Tuesday North Clubhouse bingo. Our wish is to have a bingo caller club of 4 or more persons. This way you would only have to call once a month or be fill in.
